lines.en: For years, he served the emperor. They called him the honey wine server.
He knew how to pour without spilling a single drop.
And he knew how to disappear quietly into the room.
One night, at a formal gathering, guests filled the long tables.
A guest asked whether the emperor even knew his name.
He lowered his eyes in silence, and said nothing.
The great emperor set down his glass and asked for his name.
Hearing Tesfaye, he raised a toast, and the whole hall lifted their glasses.
My grandmother said he spent his life serving the emperor.
But that night, for one moment, the whole room remembered the man behind the tray.
